Amara / SolTech Legal —

Thanks for the clear asks. Quick summary of Redwood's practical positions and a proposed compromise below. I've attached a light redline to the MSA focused only on the indemnity and notice/evidence sections (see SolTech_MSA_v3_redlines.docx).

Proposed compromise (short form):
- Trigger: Redwood will defend & indemnify for third-party claims alleging infringement of a third party's intellectual property to the extent such claim arises solely from Redwood's Services as delivered (i.e., not customer-supplied prompts or customer-uploaded models).
- Defense control: Redwood will lead defense with customer approval for settlement decisions that materially affect customer's rights. If customer reasonably objects to vendor counsel, parties will seek joint counsel or a triage call within 5 business days.
- Cap & insurance: Redwood cannot accept an uncapped exposure. We propose: cap = 3x fees (12-month run-rate) for IP claims; Redwood will add an endorsement for IP coverage in its primary CGL/E&O policy where available and provide insurer contact for offset discussions.
- Evidence & handback: Customer to provide: (i) notice of claim; (ii) copy of the claim; (iii) access to logs/outputs necessary to validate the claim; Redwood will preserve relevant runtime artifacts for 30 days on request and work with ops to export a forensics bundle.

Operational ask: to make the evidence handback workable we suggest adding a 72-hour triage window for initial evidence collection and then a 14-day evidence staging window to assemble the full package (with extensions by mutual consent). I'll include an ops checklist in the RFI response (RFI-evidence-list.xlsx).

If this sounds broadly acceptable, can we lock language and then push to an internal Exec approval ribbon? Jordan — please propose the call times you suggested; Amara, Evan — any preference for Thu 11/30 10am PT?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

Rishi —

Appreciate the thoughtful compromise. A couple of quick notes from SolTech Legal after a brief review:

- Cap: 3x fees is closer to acceptable but SolTech would prefer 4x for strategic customers; can Redwood confirm whether 3x is a firm ceiling or if there's any flexibility tied to insurance limits?
- Defense control: the triage approach is workable; request that Redwood commit to using counsel with relevant IP litigation experience and to provide a 24-hour acknowledgement when customer raises a conflict.
- Evidence timeline: the 72-hour triage window is reasonable; ask that Redwood document the types of runtime artifacts you can preserve (we'll use the RFI to match to our forensic needs).

We can do Thu 11/30 10:00am PT — Jordan, please send a calendar invite for a 30-min call and include a link to a shared folder for evidence artifacts.

Best,
